extDescription.message: Analyze the packaging and SEO of YouTube videos: thumbnail, title, description, tags and keyword research. Everything stays in your browser.

commandOpenPanel.message: Open or close the PackLens panel

studio.openHintOk.message: Panel opened. If you do not see it, press Alt+Shift+P.

studio.openHintFail.message: Could not open the panel. Press Alt+Shift+P.

state.notYoutubeTitle.message: This is not a YouTube page

state.notYoutubeBody.message: Open a video on youtube.com or a video editor in YouTube Studio to see its analysis.

state.emptyBody.message: Open a video on youtube.com or a video editor in YouTube Studio.

state.errorBody.message: Reload the YouTube tab and try again.

state.thumbFailed.message: The thumbnail could not be analyzed, so the score only reflects the title.

packaging.disclaimer.message: Local heuristic analysis: a guide, not a prediction of CTR.

check.tonalRange.hint.message: Flat image. Increase the contrast between the subject and the background.

check.edgeDensity.hint.message: Too many elements compete for attention. Use one focal point and less text.

check.colorfulness.hint.message: Washed-out colors. A saturated accent stands out better in the feed.

check.mobileLegibility.hint.message: It loses definition at phone size. Use large shapes and large text.

check.titleLength.hint.message: Aim for 30 to 60 characters. Mobile and search truncate longer titles.

check.titleCaps.hint.message: Whole words in capitals hurt readability and look like spam.

check.titlePunctuation.hint.message: Repeated signs or too many emoji reduce credibility.

check.titleWords.hint.message: Between 4 and 12 words gives context without dragging.

check.titleSpecificity.hint.message: Add a concrete detail (a number, a year, a result) to raise CTR.

tags.studioHint.message: No tags detected. Click "Read tags from the editor" to expand the section, or open it manually under "Show more".

seo.disclaimer.message: Local analysis of the description, tags and keyword placement. A guide, not a ranking guarantee.

seo.keywordHint.message: We check where this keyword appears in the title, description and tags.

seo.emptyKeyword.message: No keyword detected. Add tags or write a focus keyword.

check.seoDescriptionLength.hint.message: Aim for 200+ words: context, chapters and links. Long descriptions help both search and viewers.

check.seoDescriptionFirstLines.hint.message: Put the keyword and the hook in the first ~150 characters; that is what shows before "Show more".

check.seoDescriptionKeyword.hint.message: Use the keyword 2 to 4 times, naturally. Zero or six+ occurrences both hurt.

check.seoDescriptionLinks.hint.message: Add at least one relevant link or three timestamps/chapters.

check.seoDescriptionHashtags.hint.message: 3 to 5 hashtags at the end is the sweet spot. More looks like spam.

check.seoDescriptionCta.hint.message: Tell viewers what to do: subscribe, download, watch next, join Discord…

check.seoTagsCount.hint.message: 15 to 30 tags gives YouTube context without diluting relevance.

check.seoTagsKeyword.hint.message: Add your focus keyword as its own tag, exactly as written.

check.seoTagsLongTail.hint.message: Add at least three tags with two or more words (specific phrases).

check.seoTagsDuplicates.hint.message: Remove repeated tags: they waste the 500-character budget.

check.seoTagsBudget.hint.message: YouTube allows 500 characters across all tags. Stay under 400 to keep room to edit.

check.seoTitleKeyword.hint.message: The focus keyword should appear in the title, ideally near the beginning.

check.seoTitleLength.hint.message: 30 to 60 characters keeps it readable on mobile and in search.

keywords.intro.message: Estimated difficulty and interest from the top 10 results. This is not search volume.

keywords.sessionWarning.message: Experimental mode: reads the YouTube results page with your session. Rounded views, no subscriber counts, and YouTube may throttle it. Do not use it at scale.

keywords.errorSession.message: Could not read the YouTube search page. It may be asking for consent or throttling you; try again in a few minutes or use the API.

keywords.noKeyBody.message: Keyword research uses the YouTube Data API with your own key. Add it in Settings; it stays in your browser.

keywords.errorQuota.message: Daily API quota exhausted. Try again tomorrow or use another key.

keywords.errorKey.message: The API key was rejected. Check it in Settings and make sure YouTube Data API v3 is enabled.

keywords.error.message: The search could not be completed. Try again in a moment.

keywords.empty.message: Type a keyword to see its difficulty and the top 10 results.

keywords.patternStart.message: $1 of $2 put the keyword at the start

keywords.tagsIntro.message: Use the tags from the top 10. Copy them or apply them in Studio.

keywords.approx.message: Approximate difficulty: subscriber data is not available.

keywords.addTagsConfirm.message: Add $1 tags to the editor? Studio may save them automatically.

keywords.addTagsFallback.message: Could not write to Studio. Tags copied: paste them with Ctrl+V.

keywords.addTagsNone.message: All suggested tags are already present or do not fit the limit.

keywords.addOnlyStudio.message: Open the video in Studio to apply it automatically.

keywords.titleDisclaimer.message: Drafts based on the top 10 patterns. Edit them before applying.

keywords.titleConfirm.message: The current title will be replaced. Studio may save it automatically.

keywords.titleFallback.message: Could not write to Studio. Title copied: paste it with Ctrl+V.

keywords.advancedTitlesHint.message: Uses the top 10 patterns to create 10 scored variants. No AI; nothing leaves your browser.

keywords.advancedTitlesLocked.message: Pro compares the top 10 titles, detects their patterns and scores 10 variants. The basic drafts above stay free.

keywords.insightStart.message: $1/$2 top titles start with the keyword

outliers.empty.message: The channel feed has no videos with public views.

outliers.hint.message: Views compared to the channel median. High values mean the video broke the pattern.

panel.openHint.message: If the panel does not open, click the PackLens icon in the toolbar.

license.freeHint.message: Free features stay free. Activate a key to unlock Pro.

license.offline.message: No connection. Pro stays active during the 7-day grace period.

license.offlineExpired.message: No connection. Reconnect to validate Pro; the offline grace has expired.

license.errorGeneric.message: Could not reach Lemon Squeezy. Try again.

license.errorNetwork.message: Network error. Check your connection and try again.

description.intro.message: Analyze the current description, build a cleaner version and add 3 hashtags. Nothing is applied until you confirm.

description.noIssues.message: The description covers the basics. You can still generate a cleaner version.

description.advancedLocked.message: Pro adds terms and hashtags from the top 10 results.

description.confirm.message: The current description will be replaced. Studio may save it automatically.

description.fallback.message: Could not write to Studio. Description copied: paste it with Ctrl+V.

description.fallbackCopied.message: Could not write to Studio. Description copied: paste it with Ctrl+V.

description.onlyStudio.message: Open the video in Studio to apply the description.

description.errorNoKeyword.message: Search a keyword first to analyze the competition.

description.errorNoKey.message: Add your YouTube API key in Settings to analyze the competition.

description.errorQuota.message: Not enough YouTube API quota to analyze the competition.

description.issue.length.message: Add more context: aim for 200+ words.

description.issue.first-lines.message: The keyword is missing from the first lines.

description.issue.keyword.message: The keyword appears too little or too often.

description.issue.links.message: Add a relevant link or chapters.

description.issue.tags.message: Some tags are missing from the description.

description.issue.chapters.message: Add at least 3 timestamps if the video has chapters.

performance.noVideoBody.message: The performance review appears when a YouTube video is open.

performance.intro.message: A 48-hour review based on public data and the metadata you published.

performance.pending.message: The 48-hour review will be ready in about $1 hours.

performance.pendingHint.message: Keep the current title, tags and description stable until then to measure the real result.

performance.improvement.below-median.message: Below the channel pace; review title, thumbnail and topic.

performance.improvement.engagement-low.message: Low engagement; add a clearer call to action.

performance.improvement.keyword-missing.message: Keyword is missing from the title.

performance.improvement.tags-low.message: Few tags; add more relevant ones.

performance.disclaimer.message: The channel median is historical and not a first-48-hour benchmark. It is a signal, not proof of cause.

performance.partial.message: Some stats are unavailable. Add your YouTube API key or import the CSV for a complete review.

performance.csv.hint.message: Export Analytics → Advanced mode → Content and select Datos de la tabla.csv. It is processed locally.

performance.csv.locked.message: Pro imports the Studio CSV and adds CTR, impressions, AVD and average viewed.

performance.csv.zip.message: The ZIP contains several files. Extract Datos de la tabla.csv and select that CSV.

performance.csv.noMatch.message: This video is not in the CSV. Check the date range or export again.
